component.name: Skillscout
component.summary: See the skills your coding agents load

description.p: Skillscout finds every skill your coding agents load, shows which agents can see each one, and counts how often you use them. It knows Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Droid, Pi and Amp.
Skillscout is a fork of Skill Cabinet 1.5.0 by Flavio Copes, released under the MIT license.

ul.li: Add a skill to the agents that miss it with one click
Edit, rename, merge and uninstall skills, with uninstalled ones going to the Trash
See how often each skill gets used, from your local chats
Find the requests you keep typing, and turn them into new skills with AI
